summary: Put a visible, traceable watermark on PDFs before you share them. Runs offline and asks for no access.
description: Marks PDFs before you send them to someone. Each file gets its own ID, and the name of the person it is for is printed on every page, so a leaked copy leads back to the copy it came from. You choose the colour, strength, angle, size and spacing of the tiled text, and can add corner stamps with the ID and page number, a band along the bottom edge, and closer marks over the bottom quarter of each page. Several files can be marked at once and saved as a ZIP with a small receipt. Everything runs inside the tool window: your PDFs are not uploaded, stored or sent anywhere, and the tool asks Sanctum for no access at all. The marks deter and trace. Someone with a PDF editor can remove them.
